selection: One representative point per configuration, selected visually before estimator evaluation; not the full 400+ run dataset.
state_method: Mundt Eq. 4.1 pressure fit, ideal premixed CH4/O2 at 300 K; total flow from exact annular exit area and mass flux, except directly tabulated Run 937.
cell_size_method: Approximate visual readings of Figure 4.2, bilinear interpolation in phi and pressure; no kinetic integration or wave-count fitting.

reference_grid.reading_precision: Approximate readings, roughly 0.05--0.10 mm; tested with additional +/-20% scale variation, not statistical uncertainty.

operating_point_precision: Figure-derived phi approximately +/-0.03 and flux approximately +/-5 kg/(s m2); Run 937 directly tabulated. These are reading estimates, not experimental confidence intervals.

cases.reference_speed_source: Tabulated calculated CJ reference; no measured frequency or wave count used as estimator input
